variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity Chinese desktop web app UI screenshot for "未然 EDU", a university teacher assessment insight platform. Landscape 16:10, straight flat screenshot filling canvas; no browser/device/perspective. Main request: ALL navigation is integrated into TOP HORIZONTAL NAVIGATION, absolutely NO LEFT SIDEBAR, NO left navigation rail, no duplicate navigation. Top header 64px tall: blue "未然 EDU" brand left, tabs "学情洞察" (active), "画像探索", "测评数据" toward center-left, small "帮助" and "教师账号" right. Under header, page title "学情洞察", batch selector "程序设计 · 第一次测评" at title-row right, "全屏" small action. Small persistent "演示数据". Crisp realistic Chinese typography, excellent contrast, visual hierarchy and thoughtful spacing; blue-white brand, pale blue-gray canvas, elegant charts and clearly legible labels. Three modest summary metrics "参与学生 105", "评价记录 525", "能力维度 5". Demo data only. Five dimensions exactly "算法与数据结构" "代码实现能力" "问题建模能力" "效率意识" "解题策略". Scores 1–5, demo averages 2.8,3.5,3.2,3.6,4.1. One key insight titled "策略表现较好，算法基础仍需关注" with chips "解题策略 ≥ 4" "算法与数据结构 < 3", result "21 / 105 人 · 20%", green small status "统计已核验". Explain cautiously "能力差异的原因仍需结合题目与答题过程验证" and amber "解释待验证". Actions "查看依据" and "分析这组学生". Original comments visible as anonymous DEMO evidence, no question-level grades or nonexistent uploaded PDF. Use sample original quote "能够提出解题思路，但算法选择与边界处理仍需加强。" source "评价.xlsx · Sheet1 · 第18行". No fake growth curves, attendance, rankings, grade pass rate or general chatbot. No glowing frames, huge decorative graphics, generic marketing hero or 3D. Do not duplicate the same five mean scores in multiple charts. This is an implementable attractive analytical application with focused visuals, not a slide. VARIANT H — airy white precision. Top header white with thin border; selected tab blue text with short underline. Canvas almost white, no shadows, fine gray dividers, 8px radius, restrained royal blue. Broad 36px margins. Header title left and batch right. Three metrics a single unboxed row with thin vertical separators. Main content two columns: 65% large "五维能力概况" card with beautiful five horizontal bars on 1–5 scale and end values; below within same card a compact original-comment evidence table with columns "主题" "原文示例" "来源", rows "边界处理" "调试方法", small blue 查看 links. Right 35% tall insight inspector: small "重点发现" label, the key insight, 21/105 and20% prominent, two condition chips, verified status, "查看依据", short explanation awaiting verification, primary blue action "分析这组学生" anchored bottom. Bottom full-width simple two-row list "继续探索" offering "按能力组合查找学生" and "查看待复核评价" with arrow links, no unrequested counts. Balanced roomy minimal layout, analytic sophistication, all content fits visible viewport. Main focus clear chart and interpretable insight.
